# Fuji Press

> Academic publisher specializing in peer-reviewed journals on robotics, computational intelligence, manufacturing technology, and disaster research.

Fuji Press publishes several flagship journals including the Journal of Robotics and Mechatronics (JRM), Journal of Advanced Computational Intelligence and Intelligent Informatics (JACIII), and International Journal of Automation Technology (IJAT). The site tracks most-downloaded papers across these journals to highlight trending research topics.

## Key Topics

- Journal of Robotics and Mechatronics (JRM)
- JACIII (Computational Intelligence)
- IJAT (Manufacturing Technology)
- Autonomous Vehicles
- Machine Learning
- Robotics
- Robot Localization
- Manufacturing Technology
- Industry 4.0
- Disaster Research
- Earthquake-Tsunami Studies
- Deep Learning
- Data Mining
- Path Planning
- Non-Destructive Inspection

## Journal Homepages

- [JRM – Journal of Robotics and Mechatronics](https://www.fujipress.jp/new_pub/rbnew): JRM journal homepage featuring robotics, mechatronics, best papers and special issues.

## Call for Papers & Submissions

- [JRM Regular Papers](https://www.fujipress.jp/cfp/rb-cfp-rg): JRM call for papers and manuscript submission guidelines for regular papers.

## Most Downloaded Papers – Robotics & Mechatronics

- [JRM Most Downloaded Papers, Oct. 2019](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/rb-dl2019_10): JRM most downloaded papers for October 2019 on robotics, autonomous vehicles and localization.
- [JRM Most Downloaded Papers, Jul.-Aug. 2017](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/rb-dl2017_0708): JRM most downloaded papers for July-August 2017 on robotics and deep learning.
- [JRM Most Downloaded Papers, Mar. 2018](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/rb-dl2018_03): JRM most downloaded papers for March 2018 on autonomous vehicles and path planning.

## Most Downloaded Papers – Computational Intelligence

- [JACIII Most Downloaded Papers, Sep. 2020](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/jc-dl2020_09): JACIII most downloaded papers for September 2020 on machine learning and optimization.
- [JACIII Most Downloaded Papers, Aug. 2019](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/jc-dl2019_08): JACIII most downloaded papers for August 2019 on machine learning and computational intelligence.
- [JACIII Most Downloaded Papers, Mar. 2019](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/jc-dl2019_03): JACIII most downloaded papers for March 2019 on machine learning and data mining.
- [JACIII Most Downloaded Papers, October 2014](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/jc-dl201410): JACIII most downloaded papers for October 2014 with download statistics and rankings.

## Most Downloaded Papers – Manufacturing & Technology

- [IJAT Most Downloaded Papers, Nov. 2018](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/au-dl2018_11): IJAT most downloaded papers for November 2018 on manufacturing technology and Industry 4.0.
- [IJAT Most Downloaded Papers, May 2016](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/au-dl201605): IJAT most downloaded papers for May 2016 on composite materials and manufacturing.

## Most Downloaded Papers – Disaster Research

- [JDR Most Downloaded Papers, Apr. 2019](https://www.fujipress.jp/most_dl/dr-dl2019_04): JDR most downloaded papers for April 2019 covering disaster research and earthquake-tsunami topics.
